[[File:Joseph Lake portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Joseph Lake.]]
'''Joseph Lake''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 33 FL from Taylor, Mi. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| August 1999 – January 2001
| [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 33, Corellia region; Taylor, MI<ref name="decsq-corellia">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/corellia.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Corellia], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115090200/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/corellia.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
